files.name: WindowCounts.java

tests.name: Window and threshold boundaries
tests.description: Use [4,7,7,2,9], window [1,4), threshold 7; then [0,5), threshold 7; then [3,3).
tests.expected: 2, then 3, then 0; the original array is unchanged.

tests.name: Invalid ranges and null
tests.description: Try null; negative from; to beyond length; reversed endpoints.
tests.expected: NullPointerException for null; IllegalArgumentException for each invalid range.

reasoning: The window [1,4) reads only 7,7,2, so exactly two values meet 7. In [0,5), the final 9 adds one more.
The loop stops before to, so to == length never becomes an array access. It reads the array but never assigns an element.
